title: Payroll Executive
description:
As a Payroll Executive, you'll handle the day-to-day administration of payroll for a range of clients, ensuring accuracy and compliance. This role is key to helping the business deliver a reliable and efficient service to its clients.

Client Details

Our client is based in Portsmouth, and due to a busy period and various ongoing projects, the Payroll team is looking for additional support.

Description
- Manage end-to-end payroll processing for multiple clients.
- Ensure compliance with payroll regulations and legislation.
- Handle payroll queries and provide timely resolutions.
- Maintain accurate payroll records and documentation.
- Assist with payroll reporting and reconciliation tasks.
- Support the implementation of updates to payroll systems and processes.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth payroll operations.
- Stay informed on changes to payroll legislation and industry standards.

Profile

A successful Payroll Executive should have:
- Experience in payroll processing and administration.
- A good understanding of payroll legislation and compliance requirements.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Proficiency in payroll software and Microsoft Office applications.
- Effective communication skills to liaise with clients and internal teams.
- A proactive and problem-solving mindset.

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £29,000 to £32,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Permanent position.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Receptionist - Kingston Crescent Surgery
description: Do you have a keen interest in health care? Do you get job satisfaction from helping people? We are currently looking for an experienced receptionist to join our team. If you can work under pressure to high standards, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and can deliver a high quality of care in a busy professional environment, we would like to hear from you! We have one position available for 18 hours per week, please read the vacancy pack for full information on the working hours. Previous applicants need not apply. To provide high quality reception and general office / administration tasks, relating to the Practices provision of excellent primary healthcare and the smooth, effective running of the Practice. To be a key member of the Practice reception team, working to ensure patients are greeted and navigated courteously and that all reception tasks and administration are completed within Practice policies in a timely manner. Please see our comprehensive vacancy pack to the right (or at the very bottom if you are on a mobile), for the full job description and person specification, in order to complete your application.
